sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and may be frozen. It preserves the applicability-gated case target, uses the exact controlled applicability value, validates all declared operand and result terms at their authoritative owners, preserves the required ship-to-case and case-to-lookup relationships, and uses the declared units without inventing formula execution or evidence obligations. Deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not make every nltl:ship satisfy sh:minCount 1 for nltl:hasBowSubregionCalculationCase. The requirement applies only to ships whose bow-subregion case is classified as nltl:i231vBowFormApplicability; requiring an applicable case on every targeted ship invents an existence/applicability obligation and can create accidental failures. Preserve the case-level applicability value and all declared readiness operands, relationships, and result, but gate the readiness constraints on the supplied applicability evidence rather than forcing that case to exist universally.

Preserve the applicability-gated design from the prior feedback, but do not target every subject that merely has nltl:bowFormApplicabilityClassification. The current sh:targetSubjectsOf target also selects cases classified as other bow forms and then forces nltl:i231vBowFormApplicability, causing accidental failures. Restrict the readiness shape target to cases whose classification value is exactly nltl:i231vBowFormApplicability (for example with a value-filtered SPARQL target), or use an equivalent conditional alternative with a non-I2.3.1(v) branch that imposes no readiness constraints. Do not introduce a universal ship-level existence requirement.

The candidate is semantically faithful and may be frozen. It preserves the applicability-gated case target, uses the exact controlled applicability value, validates all declared operand and result terms at their authoritative owners, preserves the required ship-to-case and case-to-lookup relationships, and uses the declared units without inventing formula execution or evidence obligations. Deterministic validation is valid.
